item.title: Indiana doctor loses license after illegal abortion and sex with patients
item.description: Indiana's AG said a Jasper County physician lost his ability to practice medicine for committing an illegal abortion and having sexual contact with patients.

item.title: Baby boy beats winter storm's arrival in Pennsylvania roadside delivery
item.description: Hours before a massive winter storm hit multiple states, a baby boy was born on the side of a highway in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. EMS responded quickly.

item.title: GET THE FACTS: Euthanasia, assisted suicide, and palliative care are not the same
item.description: Well-meaning Americans have been misled by those who intentionally conflate palliative care with euthanasia and assisted suicide.

item.title: Britain’s 'assisted dying' bill debate risks turning care into coercion
item.description: Hospice leaders warn that the push for legalized 'assisted dying' in the UK may lead to a significant number of conscience-based staff resignations.

item.title: Barbara Pierce Bush headlines Planned Parenthood awards in Texas
item.description: The Bush family legacy surrounding abortion and Planned Parenthood was, and remains, complicated.

item.title: Ireland's health officials refuse to answer questions about abortion survivors
item.description: Ireland's Health Service Executive refuses to answer serious, legitimate questions about the treatment of babies who survive late-term abortions.

item.title: She thought an unplanned pregnancy meant life was over. God told her it had just begun.
item.description: Vanessa and Craig, ages 19 and 18 respectively, were high school sweethearts in love. Vanessa had been doing her best to follow Jesus and Craig had just recently come to know Christ. It was the summer after Vanessa’s senior year and she had plans for college at the University of California Riverside, where she was also set to be a track and field athlete.

item.title: Indiana Senate passes bill to stop abortion pill trafficking
item.description: The Indiana Senate passed a bill last week that would curtail illegal abortion pill distribution in the state by allowing private lawsuits against those who manufacture, prescribe, or distribute the pill.

item.title: Claire Danes shares the fear and beauty of a surprise pregnancy
item.description: Actress Claire Danes, who underwent IVF to conceive her second son with husband Hugh Dancy, shared the shock, fear, and beauty of her surprise pregnancy with their third child, a daughter, when Danes was 44.

item.title: Zimbabwe lawmakers consider radical expansion of abortion law
item.description: Zimbabwe's lawmakers are considering a bill that would radically expand the nation's abortion laws — a troubling development in a predominantly Christian country.
